company_name: Metalla Royalty & Streaming Ltd. Common Shares
title: METALLA REPORTS STRONG FINANCIAL RESULTS FOR THE THIRD QUARTER OF 2026 AND CASH FLOW FROM CÔTÉ AND LA PARRILLA ROYALTIES
summary: Vancouver, Canada: Metalla Royalty & Streaming Ltd. (“Metalla” or the “Company”) (TSXV: MTA) (NYSE American: MTA) announces its operating and financial results for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026. For complete details of the condensed interim consolidated financial statements and accompanying management's discussion and analysis (“MD&A”) for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, please see the Company's filings on SEDAR+ (www.sedarplus.ca) or EDGAR (www.sec.gov). Shareholders are encouraged to visit the Company's website at www.metallaroyalty.com.
